SOURCE_RECEIPT.capture: GET feed with x-api-key; POST /getoffers in batches of 25; rate-limit sleep between batches.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.local_evidence: All feed capped at 500 offers; 500/500 complete sale/list price pairs in the local test; 354 catalog product families after variant grouping.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.variant_policy: Group by offer title + price; variant count retained; model/color/size variants are not separate catalog rows.
SOURCE_RECEIPT.limitations: Developer-key access is not an independent rights review; feed data quality varies.

PAGING_RECEIPT.strategy: Single named feed with optional page parameter; current adapter caps at the requested maximum.
PAGING_RECEIPT.page_2_evidence: Feed pagination documented; current local run used the capped first set.

PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.regular_price_role: Item ListPrice from offer detail when greater than sale price.
PRICE_EXTRACTION_RECEIPT.rejections: Items without a sale price are skipped; list price is never invented.

RIGHTS_RECEIPT.note: User-supplied developer key; purpose, storage and redistribution rights remain to be reviewed.
